# ICP Intelligence

> ICP Intelligence is a free web app and AI connector with nine ideal customer profile tools, by Shashwat Ghosh of Helix GTM Consulting, for founders and demand generation heads. Give it your best customers, deals and market numbers, and it returns an ICP, TAM, SAM and SOM, and account priorities. Add https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/mcp in Claude or ChatGPT, no sign-in.

- Web app (no sign-in): https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/
- MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in, read-only tools): https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/mcp
- Connect to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf: https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/connect/
- Docs (MCP and REST, every field): https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/docs/
- FAQ: https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/faq/
- Privacy policy: https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/privacy/
- Terms of use: https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/terms/
- Local npm package: @shashwatgtmalpha/icp-intelligence-mcp
- Source code: https://github.com/shashwatgtm/icp-intelligence-mcp
- Built by: Shashwat Ghosh, Helix GTM Consulting (https://www.gtmexpert.com)
- All connectors and Claude plugins: https://tools.gtmhelix.com/

## Tools

- [ICP Deep Dive](https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/tools/icp-deep-dive/) (`icp_deep_dive`): Analyze customer data to detect ICP patterns (industry, size, deal size, sales cycle, tech stack, triggers, champion roles). Ties are named as ties, the budget is the ACV range seen in your customers, and sector notes are added when your inputs name one of the supported sectors
- [ICP Scoring Model](https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/tools/icp-scoring-model/) (`icp_scoring_model`): Create a lead qualification scoring template: criteria with example point weights set by importance level, example points for each value you list, a scorecard and tier bands to adjust. Your success pattern is matched to your criteria; it does not set the weights. Sector notes are added when your inputs name one of the supported sectors
- [Buyer Group Analyzer](https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/tools/buyer-group-analyzer/) (`buyer_group_analyzer`): Map the buyer group for a deal: the champion you name, your known stakeholders placed by their titles (economic buyer, technical evaluator, reviewers, users), each role's concern and message prompts, an influence map and discovery questions. Sector roles and questions are added when your inputs name one of the supported sectors
- [TAM SAM SOM Calculator](https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/tools/tam-sam-som-calculator/) (`tam_sam_som_calculator`): Calculate TAM/SAM/SOM bottom-up from your company count, ACV, ICP match rate and Year 1 share (calculation framework, not a data source). Sector notes are added when your inputs name one of the supported sectors
- [Lookalike Signal Generator](https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/tools/lookalike-signal-generator/) (`lookalike_signal_generator`): Generate platform-specific targeting criteria and search queries from your firmographics, technographics, champion titles and buying triggers (generates criteria, not data). Each trigger gets its own signal; search keywords come from what you sell and the sector; platforms limits the sections
- [Account Prioritization](https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/tools/account-prioritization/) (`account_prioritization`): Rank and prioritize accounts by a weighted score of fit, intent, relationship and timing; each account shows the points its timing earned and the factor that added the most points
- [ICP Gap Analysis](https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/tools/icp-gap-analysis/) (`icp_gap_analysis`): Analyze gaps between your current customer base and your ideal ICP: what the ideal profile has that the current base lacks, metric gaps from your current and target figures, causes to check and actions that fit your business model. Sector notes are added when your inputs name one of the supported sectors
- [ICP Evolution Tracker](https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/tools/icp-evolution-tracker/) (`icp_evolution_tracker`): Review how your ICP should evolve: reads your recent wins, losses and market changes against your current ICP, states a candidate change for each (an addition to test, a disqualifier to test, an implication to check) and writes a draft of the updated ICP, with the roles your ICP does not name, the loss reasons to tag and what to pull from your CRM. It does not compute win rates; check each candidate against your CRM
- [ICP Interview Synthesizer](https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/tools/icp-interview-synthesizer/) (`icp_interview_synthesizer`): Extract ICP patterns from customer interview notes: pain points, objections, buying triggers, value realized, champion roles and quotes kept word for word, with discovery questions and sector notes. Pasted notes are shown back (shortened) with a template to structure them; only structured notes are analysed.

## Questions and answers

### What is ICP Intelligence?

ICP Intelligence is a free web app and AI connector with nine ideal customer profile tools, by Shashwat Ghosh of Helix GTM Consulting, for founders and demand generation heads. Give it your best customers, deals and market numbers, and it returns an ICP, TAM, SAM and SOM, and account priorities. Add https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/mcp in Claude or ChatGPT, no sign-in.

### Is ICP Intelligence free, and do I need an account?

It is free, and there is no account or sign-in. Use the tools in your browser here, or add them to Claude or ChatGPT as a connector.

### Does it use AI to write the answers?

No. Each tool applies fixed rules in the ICP Intelligence code to the inputs you give it. It does not call an AI model and does not look anything up. When you use it from Claude or another assistant, that assistant writes around the tool's answer.

### What happens to what I type?

It is sent to this site's server, used once to build the answer, and dropped when the answer is sent back. Nothing is stored and nothing you type is logged. The privacy page has the details.

### How do I use ICP Intelligence in Claude?

In Claude, open Customize, then Connectors, select + and then Add custom connector. Name it ICP Intelligence, paste https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/mcp and leave the sign-in fields empty. The page Use it in Claude or ChatGPT covers Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf too.

### Who built it?

Shashwat Ghosh, Co-Founder and Fractional CMO of Helix GTM Consulting, founded in 2022 in Bengaluru. He has 24+ years in B2B and 10+ years of fractional experience, and created the EPIC, IMPACT and CRAFT frameworks and the Hub-Spoke Brand Messaging Methodology.

### Why do some answers look like templates?

Several tools return a structured plan with [placeholders] where your inputs did not give a fact. When an answer shows a benchmark, target, rate, weight or other figure you did not supply, it is labelled "Example figure: replace with your own". Figures calculated from your inputs are not labelled. Suggested lengths, timings and counts are marked as suggestions. Replace every example and placeholder before you use the result.

### Can I call the tools from my own code?

Yes. Send POST https://icp-intelligence.gtmhelix.com/api/tools/<tool name> with a JSON body {"input": {...}}. The Docs page lists every field. Please keep to the rate limit of 30 requests per minute.

### Is the source code public?

Yes, at https://github.com/shashwatgtm/icp-intelligence-mcp under the MIT licence. The npm package @shashwatgtmalpha/icp-intelligence-mcp runs these tools locally; it can lag behind this site until a new version is published.

### Who is ICP Intelligence not ideal for?

Teams looking for a list of companies to target: the tools describe and score profiles from your data but find no companies. Market sizing without your own numbers: TAM, SAM and SOM are built from the figures you enter; an ICP match rate or market share you leave out is filled with a labelled example (30% and 3%). Teams that need saved models or CRM sync: nothing is stored and no CRM is connected.

### How do I report a problem?

Email shashwat@gtmhelix.com or open an issue at https://github.com/shashwatgtm/icp-intelligence-mcp/issues.
